name: Check entry and transit requirements
short_description: Check entry and transit requirements once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can check entry and transit requirements in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Check entry and transit requirements means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
